picnic.note: Craigtoun picnic benches are outside Denhead.

parking.note: Official route says parking is limited between Ceres and Craigtoun.

accessibility.note: Mixed rough grass, gravel, muddy woodland and unpavemented road.

exclusions: Craigtoun Country Park café, toilets, picnic tables and attractions are outside Denhead.
St Andrews services are not transferred.
boundaryRule: The through-route remains in Trails but does not lift the hamlet score.
